description: Enable a PostgreSQL extension on a project's Neon database. Supports pgvector (vector similarity search for RAG), postgis (geographic data), pg_trgm (fuzzy text search), uuid-ossp (UUID generation). For pgvector, specify a preset to auto-configure dimensions and indexing. IMPORTANT: HNSW/IVFFlat indexes are limited to 2000 dimensions — presets above this (openai-3-large at 3072) auto-fallback to no index. Use openai-3-small (1536 dims) for indexed similarity search. Returns configuration details and code samples (Python + TypeScript) for using the extension. Use when auto-detection missed vector dependencies or when manually enabling extensions.

create_sample_table.description: Create a sample embeddings table with vector column and HNSW index (pgvector only).

extension.description: Extension name: pgvector, postgis, pg_trgm, or uuid-ossp.

preset.description: Embedding preset for pgvector: openai-ada-002, openai-3-small, openai-3-large, claude, cohere-english, sentence-transformers.

name: enable_database_extension
